animated.note: The bar transitions smoothly as the value updates. Click play to watch it run from 0 to 100.

buffer.note: Buffer renders the expected value behind the fill — useful for streaming and chunked uploads.

progress.description: Linear bar that communicates the progress of a task, either with a measurable determinate value or as an indeterminate indicator when the duration is unknown.

examples.note: Determinate value, label with percent, and indeterminate mode. The snippet shows the minimal template.

indeterminate.note: Use indeterminate when the duration is unknown. The bar slides until the process finishes.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris UI package and import the progress component.

props.note: Full props reference lives in the component documentation.

size-density.note: Adapted matrix: size drives the bar thickness, density only scales the label. The snippet reflects the current selection.

status.note: Active follows the color input; success and exception tint the bar. The snippet reflects the current selection.

stripes.note: Diagonal stripes, optionally animated. Animation stays static under reduced motion. The snippet reflects the current selection.
